claims.statement: Receding horizon control uses the latest T_o observations to predict T_p actions, executes T_a actions without replanning, then updates the plan.

evidence_locator.section: II.C. Diffusion for Visuomotor Policy Learning; Closed-loop action-sequence prediction

claims.scope: T_o is the observation horizon, T_p the prediction horizon, and T_a the execution horizon in the method formulation.
claims.unsupported_extension: This passage does not fix one horizon configuration for every task.

claims.statement: The reported real-world DDIM configuration uses 100 training denoising iterations and 10 inference iterations, with 0.1-second inference latency on an Nvidia 3080 GPU.

evidence_locator.section: III.D. Accelerating Inference for Real-time Control

numeric_facts.condition: DDIM training configuration in the reported real-world experiments
DDIM inference configuration in the reported real-world experiments
Inference latency on an Nvidia 3080 GPU with the reported DDIM configuration

claims.scope: The iteration counts concern diffusion, not optimizer epochs.
claims.unsupported_extension: The timing is not a hardware-independent latency guarantee.

claims.statement: For visual Transport with proficient-human demonstrations, Table II reports DiffusionPolicy-C at 1.00/0.93 and LSTM-GMM at 0.88/0.62; each pair is maximum-checkpoint performance followed by the last-ten-checkpoint average.
